issues.message: A credential-shaped value was committed in plain text (DEMO_API_TOKEN).
issues.impact: Anyone with repository access can reuse the committed credential-shaped value.
issues.evidence: The added line assigns DEMO_API_TOKEN to a literal value in config/demo-tokens.txt.
issues.suggestion: Remove the secret from version control and load it from the environment instead.
issues.verification: Remove the literal and rerun the review fixture; the finding should disappear.

summary: The change adds config/demo-tokens.txt, which commits plaintext credential-shaped values.
